title: John Chapter 8 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on John chapter 8 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: John Chapter 8 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of John Chapter 8.

questions.question: In John 8, which of the following appears FIRST in the chapter?
options: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.
The scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery.
Jesus said, I am the light of the world.
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.
questions.explanation: This is the first event described in the chapter, found in John 8:1.

questions.question: Where did Jesus go early in the morning?
questions.correctAnswer: Into the temple
questions.explanation: In John 8:2, it states that he came again into the temple.

questions.question: Who brought the woman taken in adultery to Jesus?
questions.correctAnswer: The Pharisees
questions.explanation: According to John 8:3, the scribes and Pharisees brought the woman to Jesus.

questions.question: What did the Pharisees say the woman was taken in?
questions.correctAnswer: In adultery
questions.explanation: In John 8:4, it states that they said the woman was taken in adultery.

questions.question: What did Moses command should happen to someone taken in adultery?
questions.correctAnswer: They should be stoned
questions.explanation: John 8:5 mentions that Moses in the law commanded that such should be stoned.

questions.question: What did Jesus do when tempted by the Pharisees?
questions.correctAnswer: He wrote on the ground
questions.explanation: In John 8:6, it describes how Jesus stooped down and wrote on the ground.

questions.question: What did Jesus say to the accusers of the woman?
options: Let him who is without sin cast the first stone
questions.correctAnswer: Let him who is without sin cast the first stone
questions.explanation: In John 8:7, Jesus said, 'He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.'

questions.question: What happened to the accusers after Jesus spoke?
options: They were convicted by their conscience
questions.correctAnswer: They were convicted by their conscience
questions.explanation: John 8:9 states that they which heard it, being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one.

questions.question: What did Jesus ask the woman after her accusers left?
questions.correctAnswer: Where are your accusers?
questions.explanation: In John 8:10, Jesus asked the woman, 'Woman, where are those thine accusers?'

questions.question: What did Jesus tell the woman after her accusers left?
questions.correctAnswer: Go and sin no more
questions.explanation: In John 8:11, Jesus said to her, 'Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.'

questions.question: What claim did Jesus make about himself in John 8:12?
options: I am the bread of life
I am the light of the world
I am the way, the truth, and the life
questions.correctAnswer: I am the light of the world
questions.explanation: In John 8:12, Jesus said, 'I am the light of the world.'

questions.question: The Pharisees accused Jesus of bearing record of himself. True or False?
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: In John 8:13, the Pharisees said, 'Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.'

questions.question: Jesus stated that he knows where he came from and where he is going. True or False?
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: In John 8:14, Jesus said, 'for I know whence I came, and whither I go.'

questions.question: Jesus claimed that he judges all men. True or False?
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: In John 8:15, Jesus said, 'I judge no man.'

questions.question: Jesus taught in the marketplace. True or False?
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: In John 8:20, it states that Jesus taught in the treasury, not in the marketplace.

medium.title: John Chapter 8 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from John Chapter 8 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What did Jesus say about where he was going in John 8:21?
options: I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins
I will remain with you always
I will return to the Father
You will find me in the temple
questions.correctAnswer: I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins
questions.explanation: This is a direct quote from John 8:21, where Jesus explains the consequence of not following him.

questions.question: What does John 8:31 promise will happen if someone continues in Jesus' word?
options: They shall be my disciples indeed
They will be free from sin
questions.correctAnswer: They shall be my disciples indeed
questions.explanation: John 8:31 states that if one continues in Jesus' word, they are truly his disciples.

questions.question: What did Jesus say about those who commit sin in John 8:34?
options: They are the servant of sin
questions.correctAnswer: They are the servant of sin
questions.explanation: In John 8:34, Jesus explicitly states that whoever commits sin is a servant of sin.

questions.question: According to John 8:36, what will happen if the Son makes someone free?
options: They will be accepted by the Father
questions.correctAnswer: They shall be free indeed
questions.explanation: John 8:36 teaches that if the Son makes someone free, they are truly free.

questions.question: What did Jesus say about his relationship with the Father in John 8:29?
options: The Father hath not left me alone
I am one with the Father
The Father is distant from me
I have no knowledge of the Father
questions.correctAnswer: The Father hath not left me alone
questions.explanation: In John 8:29, Jesus affirms that the Father is always with him, indicating their close relationship.

questions.question: What does John 8:32 say about knowing the truth?
options: The truth shall make you free
Only a few will know the truth
You shall never know the truth
questions.correctAnswer: The truth shall make you free
questions.explanation: John 8:32 states that knowing the truth leads to freedom.

questions.question: What did Jesus mean by saying, 'Ye are from beneath; I am from above' in John 8:23?
options: He is of a heavenly origin
He is one with the people
questions.correctAnswer: He is of a heavenly origin
questions.explanation: In John 8:23, Jesus contrasts his divine origin with that of the people, emphasizing his heavenly nature.

questions.question: What did the Jews claim in John 8:33 about their heritage?
options: We have never seen a miracle
questions.correctAnswer: We be Abraham's seed
questions.explanation: In John 8:33, the Jews assert their lineage as descendants of Abraham.

questions.question: What significant event does Jesus refer to in John 8:28?
options: When ye have lifted up the Son of man
questions.correctAnswer: When ye have lifted up the Son of man
questions.explanation: In John 8:28, Jesus indicates the event of his crucifixion, which will reveal his true identity.

questions.question: What did Jesus say about the Jews seeking to kill him in John 8:37?
options: They seek to kill me because my word hath no place in you
They love me as their teacher
They are confused about my teachings
They have no reason to accuse me
questions.correctAnswer: They seek to kill me because my word hath no place in you
questions.explanation: John 8:37 shows that Jesus links their intent to kill him with their rejection of his teachings.

questions.question: According to John 8:25, how did the Jews respond to Jesus' claims?
questions.correctAnswer: Who art thou?
questions.explanation: In John 8:25, their response reflects confusion and skepticism regarding Jesus' identity.

questions.question: What does John 8:39 imply about the nature of true descendants of Abraham?
options: If ye were Abraham's children, ye would do the works of Abraham
questions.correctAnswer: If ye were Abraham's children, ye would do the works of Abraham
questions.explanation: This statement in John 8:39 highlights that true lineage to Abraham is evidenced by actions consistent with his faith.

questions.question: Jesus taught that continuing in his word is essential for discipleship. True or False?
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: In John 8:31, Jesus states that continuing in his word is necessary to be his disciples.

questions.question: The Pharisees were supportive of Jesus' teachings. True or False?
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: The Pharisees often opposed Jesus, as seen throughout the chapter.

questions.question: Jesus claimed that he was the light of the world. True or False?
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Jesus indeed claimed to be the light of the world in John 8:12.

hard.title: John Chapter 8 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from John Chapter 8.

questions.question: In John 8:41, how do the Jews respond when Jesus says, 'Ye do the deeds of your father'?
options: We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.
We are children of Abraham and do not lie.
We always obey the law of Moses.
We reject your accusations and follow the prophets.
questions.correctAnswer: We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.
questions.explanation: John 8:41 records their direct reply: 'We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.'

questions.question: According to John 8:42, what would the Jews do if God were truly their Father?
options: Ye would follow the law strictly.
Ye would not question my words.
questions.correctAnswer: Ye would love me.
questions.explanation: Jesus states in John 8:42, 'If God were your Father, ye would love me.'

questions.question: What reason does Jesus give in John 8:43 for the Jews not understanding His speech?
options: Because ye cannot hear my word.
Because ye are blinded by tradition.
Because ye do not seek the truth.
Because ye are distracted by earthly matters.
questions.correctAnswer: Because ye cannot hear my word.
questions.explanation: John 8:43 explicitly says, 'Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.'

questions.question: In John 8:44, which two characteristics are attributed to the devil?
options: He was a murderer from the beginning and is a liar.
He is a tempter and deceiver.
He rules over darkness and chaos.
He is a fallen angel and an adversary.
questions.correctAnswer: He was a murderer from the beginning and is a liar.
questions.explanation: John 8:44 states, 'He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth... for he is a liar, and the father of it.'

questions.question: What challenge does Jesus pose in John 8:46 to those who do not believe Him?
options: Which of you convinceth me of sin?
Who among you can prove my teachings wrong?
Can any of you understand my origin?
Who here has seen the Father?
questions.correctAnswer: Which of you convinceth me of sin?
questions.explanation: Jesus asks in John 8:46, 'Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?'

questions.question: According to John 8:51, what promise does Jesus give to those who keep His sayings?
options: He shall be saved from judgment.
He shall inherit the kingdom of God.
questions.correctAnswer: He shall never see death.
questions.explanation: John 8:51 says, 'If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.'

questions.question: What does the Greek word 'ἀληθής' (alēthēs) used in John 8:45 mean?
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: In John 8:45, Jesus says, 'And because I tell you the truth (ἀληθής), ye believe me not.' The Greek word 'ἀληθής' means 'true' or 'truthful.'

questions.question: Which literary device is prominently used in John 8:58 when Jesus says, 'Before Abraham was, I am'?
options: Assertion of divine identity (I AM statement)
questions.correctAnswer: Assertion of divine identity (I AM statement)
questions.explanation: John 8:58 uses the phrase 'I am,' echoing the divine name revealed in Exodus 3:14, asserting Jesus’ eternal existence and divinity.

questions.question: Which Old Testament passage connects to Jesus’ claim in John 8:58, 'Before Abraham was, I am'?
questions.correctAnswer: Exodus 3:14
questions.explanation: John 8:58 alludes to Exodus 3:14 where God reveals His name as 'I AM,' establishing a connection between Jesus’ divine identity and the Old Testament revelation.

questions.question: Which New Testament passage reflects the theme of truth and freedom as taught in John 8:31-32?
questions.correctAnswer: Galatians 5:1
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:1 echoes the theme of freedom in Christ: 'Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free,' connecting to John 8:31-32’s teaching on truth making one free.

questions.question: What comes immediately before Jesus’ statement in John 8:51 about never seeing death?
options: Jesus says He seeks not His own glory but the Father’s who judges.
The Jews accuse Jesus of having a devil.
Jesus honors His Father while the Jews dishonor Him.
Jesus speaks of Abraham’s joy to see His day.
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus says He seeks not His own glory but the Father’s who judges.
questions.explanation: John 8:50 precedes 8:51 and states, 'And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.'

questions.question: In John 8:44, the devil is called 'the father of it' referring to what?
questions.correctAnswer: Lies
questions.explanation: John 8:44 says, 'When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it,' identifying the devil as the originator of lies.

questions.question: What cultural or historical context underlies the Jews’ accusation in John 8:48 that Jesus is a Samaritan and has a devil?
options: Samaritans were despised and considered heretical by Jews, so calling Jesus a Samaritan was an insult.
Samaritans were known for demon possession rituals.
Samaritans were the ruling class in Jerusalem at the time.
Samaritans were considered more righteous than Jews.
questions.correctAnswer: Samaritans were despised and considered heretical by Jews, so calling Jesus a Samaritan was an insult.
questions.explanation: The historical enmity between Jews and Samaritans contextualizes John 8:48 as an attempt to discredit Jesus by associating Him with a despised group.

questions.question: How does John 8:56 indicate that Abraham had prophetic insight about Jesus?
options: Abraham rejoiced to see Jesus’ day and was glad.
Abraham wrote prophecies about the Messiah.
Abraham built altars in anticipation of Jesus.
Abraham spoke openly about Jesus’ coming.
questions.correctAnswer: Abraham rejoiced to see Jesus’ day and was glad.
questions.explanation: John 8:56 says, 'Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad,' indicating Abraham’s prophetic vision.

questions.question: True or False: In John 8:59, the Jews attempted to stone Jesus because of His claim 'Before Abraham was, I am.'
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: John 8:59 states that after Jesus said 'Before Abraham was, I am,' they took up stones to cast at him.

theological.title: John Chapter 8 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from John Chapter 8 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What doctrine does John 8:34 teach about human sin?
options: Sin is a dominion leading to spiritual servitude
Sin is merely a mistake easily forgiven
Sin is only external and does not affect the soul
questions.correctAnswer: Sin is a dominion leading to spiritual servitude
questions.explanation: John 8:34 states, 'Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin,' indicating that sin leads to spiritual bondage.

questions.question: What doctrine does John 8:51 teach about eternal life?
options: Eternal life is granted to those who keep Jesus' sayings
Eternal life is given based on works of the law
Eternal life depends on ethnic lineage
Eternal life is automatic for all humanity
questions.correctAnswer: Eternal life is granted to those who keep Jesus' sayings
questions.explanation: John 8:51 states, 'If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death,' emphasizing obedience to Jesus' word as the condition for eternal life.

questions.question: What doctrine does John 8:58 teach about the preexistence of Christ?
options: Christ existed before Abraham and identifies Himself with the divine name 'I am'
Christ began existence at birth in Bethlehem
Christ is a created being inferior to Abraham
Christ is purely human with no preexistence
questions.correctAnswer: Christ existed before Abraham and identifies Himself with the divine name 'I am'
questions.explanation: John 8:58 quotes Jesus saying, 'Before Abraham was, I am,' indicating His eternal preexistence and divine identity.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does John 8:16 specifically demonstrate?
questions.correctAnswer: Divine judgment
questions.explanation: John 8:16 says, 'my judgment is true,' showing Jesus exercising divine authority in righteous judgment.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does John 8:29 specifically demonstrate?
questions.correctAnswer: Divine obedience and faithfulness
questions.explanation: John 8:29 states Jesus does 'always those things that please him,' demonstrating His faithfulness and obedience to the Father.

questions.question: How does John 8:28 connect to the broader biblical theme of atonement?
options: Jesus predicts His crucifixion as the basis for revelation and salvation
Jesus denies the need for atonement
Jesus asserts human effort as the path to salvation
Jesus focuses only on future judgment
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus predicts His crucifixion as the basis for revelation and salvation
questions.explanation: In John 8:28, 'When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he,' Jesus alludes to His crucifixion, the central atoning event in Scripture.

questions.question: How does John 8:12 prepare for the theme of Christ as the Light in later biblical revelation?
options: It introduces Jesus as the life-giving Light overcoming darkness
It presents Jesus as a political leader
It depicts Jesus as a lawgiver only
It emphasizes Jesus' humanity without divine light
questions.correctAnswer: It introduces Jesus as the life-giving Light overcoming darkness
questions.explanation: John 8:12 states, 'I am the light of the world,' connecting to the biblical motif of divine illumination and salvation.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do John 8:34 and John 8:36 teach about sin and liberation?
options: Sin enslaves humanity but Christ alone grants true freedom
Sin has no real power, and freedom is automatic
Freedom is unrelated to Christ's work
questions.correctAnswer: Sin enslaves humanity but Christ alone grants true freedom
questions.explanation: John 8:34 teaches servitude to sin, while John 8:36 affirms that if the Son makes you free, you are free indeed, uniting bondage and liberation in Christ.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do John 8:42 and John 8:44 teach about spiritual parentage and truth?
options: Those who are of God love Christ and receive truth; those of the devil reject truth and follow lies
All humanity shares the same spiritual fatherhood
Truth is relative and not linked to spiritual origin
Jesus denies any connection to God
questions.correctAnswer: Those who are of God love Christ and receive truth; those of the devil reject truth and follow lies
questions.explanation: John 8:42 states that if God were their Father, they would love Jesus; John 8:44 describes the devil as the father of lies, contrasting spiritual parentage and truth.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do John 8:31 and John 8:32 teach about the nature of discipleship and freedom?
options: True discipleship is continuing in Jesus' word, which leads to knowing the truth and experiencing freedom
Discipleship is based on ethnic identity alone
Freedom is unrelated to truth or Jesus' word
questions.correctAnswer: True discipleship is continuing in Jesus' word, which leads to knowing the truth and experiencing freedom
questions.explanation: John 8:31-32 links abiding in Jesus' teaching with knowing truth and being made free, defining authentic discipleship.

questions.question: Sceptics claim John 8:46-47 teaches Jesus was unaware of His own sinlessness. What does this passage actually teach?
options: Jesus challenges His accusers to prove sin in Him, affirming His sinlessness and divine origin
Jesus admits ignorance of His own sin
Jesus avoids the question about sin
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus challenges His accusers to prove sin in Him, affirming His sinlessness and divine origin
questions.explanation: John 8:46-47 records Jesus asking, 'Which of you convinceth me of sin?' affirming His sinlessness and divine hearing of God's word.

questions.question: What doctrine does John 8:17 teach about the testimony validating Jesus' mission?
options: The law requires two witnesses, fulfilled by Jesus and the Father
Jesus needs no testimony for His mission
Testimony is irrelevant for divine matters
questions.correctAnswer: The law requires two witnesses, fulfilled by Jesus and the Father
questions.explanation: John 8:17 cites the law's requirement of two witnesses and applies it to Jesus bearing witness of Himself and the Father bearing witness of Him.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does John 8:55 specifically demonstrate?
questions.correctAnswer: Omniscience
questions.explanation: John 8:55 shows Jesus' knowledge of the Father, affirming His divine omniscience compared to the ignorance of His opponents.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do John 8:37 and John 8:40 teach about genuine children of Abraham?
options: True children of Abraham do the works of Abraham, including accepting God's word and truth
Physical descent alone guarantees spiritual blessing
Rejection of Jesus is consistent with Abraham's faith
Abraham's role is insignificant for salvation
questions.correctAnswer: True children of Abraham do the works of Abraham, including accepting God's word and truth
questions.explanation: John 8:37-40 contrasts those who seek to kill Jesus with the works of Abraham, teaching genuine children emulate Abraham’s faithfulness.

questions.question: How does John 8:20 contribute to the narrative arc of Jesus' ministry and divine timing?
options: It shows Jesus teaching openly yet protected until the appointed hour
It reveals Jesus' ministry was secretive and hidden
It indicates Jesus avoided the temple
It suggests Jesus was powerless to act
questions.correctAnswer: It shows Jesus teaching openly yet protected until the appointed hour
questions.explanation: John 8:20 notes Jesus spoke in the temple treasury and 'no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come,' highlighting divine timing in His ministry.
